messages.author: 94ec915e8ce36448
messages.subject: Re: [codex_wes_cnv] WGS and panel NGS
parts:
You can use it for targeted sequencing. For WGS, it can be done as well but you have to bin the genome into windows and each window is a "target" or "exon".

Yuchao
